method:
btc_weekend_study.py - does Bitcoin's weekend move tell us anything about Monday's NIFTY? (desk 21 Nov 2026 16:20). Pure code, no AI.
WEEKEND  Fri India session F followed by a weekend; N = the next India session (normally Monday). BTC move = Bitstamp BTC/USD hourly, from
         Fri 15:30 IST (open of the 10:00 UTC candle) to N 08:30 IST (close of the 02:00 UTC candle, = 03:00 UTC). 2017 onward.
TARGET   NIFTY on N: open gap and close vs F's close (Kite day candles Nov 2021 ->, Yahoo ^NSEI before).
ON TOP?  (a) 2017 ->: gap ~ Nasdaq Composite Friday change (cash, known after India's close) + BTC weekend move;
         (b) Jul 2024 ->: gap ~ NQ futures from India's Friday close (15:30 IST) to Mon 07:30 IST + BTC weekend move (Yahoo 60m, ~2 years).
         Incremental r2 and sign hit, in-sample and out-of-sample (first 60% / last 40%).
CREDIT   US high-yield spread: FRED's ICE BofA HY OAS could not be downloaded from this server (timeout), so proxies from Yahoo daily:
         HYG (iShares HY bond ETF) return, and HYG minus IEF (7-10y Treasuries) = the credit part. A 'jump' = HYG-IEF <= -0.75% in a US session
         (or HYG <= -1%). Measured on India's next session after that US date.
  python3 -I btc_weekend_study.py fetch | (no arg)
